messages.author: 96e630cb74e1964d
messages.subject: problem with making multiple plots (geom_pointrange) in a loop
parts:
Hello:

I am trying to make multiple scatter plots, using a for loop to select
only certain entries in a dataframe. Here is my code:

for(i in 1:length(ganges_subbasin[,1] )){



subbasin_select <- as.character(ganges_subbasin[i, 2])

#print(subbasin_select)

subbasin_select <- as.character(ganges_subbasin[i, 2])

p <- ggplot(ganges_subbasin_a2pre_sort ,aes(x = Month, y = med, ymin
= min, ymax = max, subset = CATCHMENT_ == subbasin_select)) +
ylab("Precipitation (mm)\n") + opts(title = paste("Projected
Precipitation 2030 - 2049 (Sub-Basin ", subbasin_select, ")\n", sep =
"")) + scale_colour_grey()


p + geom_pointrange(linetype = 2, colour = "navyblue") +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.text.y =
theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.ticks =
theme_segment(colour = "white"))


ggsave(paste(subbasin_select,"2100.jpeg", sep = " "))



}

dev.off()

Unfortunately, I get this error:

"Saving 6.95" x 6.94" image
Error in grDevices::jpeg(..., width = width, height = height, res =
dpi, :
unable to start device
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In grDevices::jpeg(..., width = width, height = height, res =
dpi, :
Unable to allocate bitmap
2: In grDevices::jpeg(..., width = width, height = height, res =
dpi, :
opening device failed
>
"

Any suggestions?

Thank you.

Michael

messages.subject: still having problems saving .jpegs in a loop
parts:
Hello:

I am still having problems saving. jpeg images of graphs in a loop.
It works intermittently. I am using the latest version of R, 2.11.0.

Here is my code:

for(i in 1:length(ganges_subbasin[,1]) ){ #length(ganges_subbasin[,1]

subbasin_select <- as.character(ganges_subbasin[i, 2])

#print(subbasin_select)

subbasin_select <- as.character(ganges_subbasin[i, 2])
p <- ggplot(ganges_subbasin_A1Bpre_sort ,aes(x = Month, y = med, ymin
= min, ymax = max, subset = CATCHMENT_ == subbasin_select)) +

ylab("Precipitation (mm)") + opts(title = paste("Simulated
Precipitation (1980 - 1999) (Sub-Basin ", subbasin_select, ")\n", sep

= "")) + scale_colour_grey()


p + geom_pointrange(linetype = 2, colour = "navyblue") +
opts(scale_y_log2('Speedup (1.0 = CPython 2.4.1)\n')) +

opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.text.y =
theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.ticks =
theme_segment(colour = "white"))

ggsave(file = paste(subbasin_select, "_2000.jpeg", sep =""))


}

dev.off()


Sometimes it works, other times I get this message:

Error in grDevices::jpeg(..., width = width, height = height, res =
dpi, :
unable to start device
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In grDevices::jpeg(..., width = width, height = height, res =
dpi, :
Unable to allocate bitmap
2: In grDevices::jpeg(..., width = width, height = height, res =
dpi, :
opening device failed

Any help appreciated.

Thanks,

Michael

messages.author: cbb14406dcfff2da
messages.subject: Re: problem with making multiple plots (geom_pointrange) in a loop
parts:
G'day,

This is just a guess, but I think you might be running into a memory
or internal memory allocation ceiling within R. I encountered a
similar error when trying to save a hi-res (1200 dpi) bitmap through
ggsave under Windows XP. Sometimes it would generate the same error
as you are getting, sometimes not. After some experimenting, I
reduced the resolution back to 300 dpi ( which is still generating a
4mb file) and problem solved. Even though you are saving jpeg's,
presumably it is being generated by shrinking a bitmap. Try varying
dimensions and dpi in ggsave and see if that helps.
cheers
Gerry

Gerry
